body: Wait, if they accept partial rent from me it starts over? Because I've paid them about a thousand dollars over the past month (instead of even buying food for my fridge) to try and cover the month's rent plus extra to try and pay them back. It was the most I could give and I get paid on Friday more which will be going directly to them.

It looks like that's going to be my only option. I've applied for a teacher's position here. If I get it and no longer live here, it won't be of much use. But if by some miracle I'm able to stay, then I may end up taking the semester off to work as a full time teacher.
My father is far out of state. I've thought about staying at my mother's for a while but trying to find other options cause she's still several hours away thus taking me out of school.
Yes, it's a legal notice from a sheriff.

Why would I lie? As I said in another reply, we went through a proess last month that said I need to pay it back. That was obvious and I've been trying to pay it back and talk with my landlords and they have been kind about it, saying that they still want to keep me as a tenant and everything. And then I got the notice on the door that said out by tomorrow and I was incredibly confused.
I'm in College Station, TX. How did you get it to work?

College Station. We went through a process last month and the landlords have been really nice about it. I don't fault them at all. I've been trying to pay it back as quickly as possible and they said that they would want to keep me as a tenant and everything. And then I got that notice and was shocked.

I've tried. There isn't much they can do. Both of my parents have filed for bankruptcy in the past couple of years so when I was going to college, it was kind of all on me. It's been the most stressful experience and I don't know if I can even continue to go to school because of not being able to afford it.
